buildCost.boundary: One fresh offline pack invocation including Cargo compilation, compatibility checks and tarball creation; warm dependency caches; no download time.

cargoDependencies.type: locked package entries listed by package BUILD.json

package.name: @binary-balance/seshat
package.description: Local Linux x64 candidate for native TypeScript code assurance

limits.order: warmup uses the fixed condition order; measured pairs alternate that order and its reverse; all top-level processes are serial
limits.wallBoundary: installed CLI process spawn through stdout/stderr drain; child report serialization is included; validation follows
limits.cacheBoundary: each invocation captures a fresh Seshat copy; host filesystem, npm, runner and OS caches remain warm
limits.hostPermissions: required for mutation child execution; EPERM is an environment failure, never a mutation verdict
